scripts.db:start: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile dev up -d postgres mailpit
scripts.db:watch: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up postgres
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --profile app --profile tools build server web migrate
scripts.test: bun test --timeout 15000 tests/policies.test.ts && bun test --timeout 15000 tests/integration.test.ts && bun test --timeout 15000 tests/learning.test.ts && bun test --timeout 20000 tests/study-loop.test.ts && bun test --timeout 20000 tests/library-account.test.ts && bun test --timeout 20000 tests/concurrency.test.ts
scripts.ops:backup: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.ops.yml -f docker-compose.release.yml --profile ops run --rm --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/backup-once.sh backup
scripts.ops:ledger: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.ops.yml -f docker-compose.release.yml --profile ops run --rm --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/ledger-once.sh backup
